text.description_html:
3.5" x 27" Stainless Steel Push Plate

This 3.5 x 27 Push Plate is made from 1.2 mm stainless steel so you know it will be able to handle both commercial and high-traffic residential applications. It has a satin stainless steel finish. The 3.5 x 27 Satin Stainless Steel Push Plate comes packaged with the installation hardware.

This push plate is great for use with the 24" Stainless Steel Thru-bolt Pull

Specifications for the Don-Jo PP-3.5x27-630 Stainless Steel Push Plate:

  • Plate Length: 27"
  • Plate Width: 3.5"
  • Plate Thickness: .050" (1.2 mm)
  • Material: 304 Stainless Steel
  • Satin Stainless Steel Finish
  • Packaged with matching stainless steel mounting screws.
  • Don-Jo PP-3.5x27-630 Dimensions (PDF)

Sold Individually
